title: Surreal Desert Dreamscape
description: A robed figure with a red backpack and mouse-like tail stands on a sand dune holding a small glowing object. In the foreground is a colorful geodesic dome with dripping paint and a glowing green puddle, while above floats a large cluster of transparent bubbles containing miniature desert scenes with cacti and figures, all beneath a giant red eye in the sky.
prompt: A surreal desert scene at twilight with rolling sand dunes. In the foreground a colorful geodesic dome with dripping paint sits next to a glowing green puddle. A robed figure with a red backpack and long mouse tail stands on a dune holding a small glowing flower. Above floats a large cluster of iridescent transparent bubbles containing miniature desert landscapes with cacti and tiny figures. A giant red eye with a black pupil floats in the dark starry sky surrounded by constellations.
